faqs.a: justify-content aligns items along the main axis (horizontal in a row), while align-items aligns them along the cross axis (vertical in a row).
faqs.q: What is the difference between justify-content and align-items?

faqs.a: flex-wrap: wrap lets items flow onto multiple lines; align-content then controls how those lines are spaced.
faqs.q: How do I make items wrap to a new line?

faqs.a: Yes — set the item count up to 12 and toggle flex-wrap to see wrapping in action.
faqs.q: Can I test with many items?

howto: Choose flex-direction, flex-wrap and the alignment properties.
Drag the gap slider to space the items.
Set how many demo items to show (1–12).
Copy the generated container CSS into your stylesheet.
